featured.title: Dissertation: Imagining possibilities for a more artful, embodied, and expressive math and science education
featured.description:
My dissertation work focuses on exploring, alongside youth, the affordances and
constraints of integrating STEM disciplines (math and science) with performing arts practices
(theatre and dance). A sixth-grade class participated in four arts-integrated math
and science activities, followed by one-on-one post interviews, in which the students reflected
on the activities and their definitions of math, science, and the arts. This work advances
understanding of how to reframe math and science education—from unfeeling, sedentary, and
objective, towards expressive, embodied, and artful.
